meta.description: Burnout, loneliness, betrayal, relationships falling apart. In-person sessions in Odesa and online. CBT-certified consultant.

hero.titleHtml: When your relationship is falling apart and you're out of strength — there is a way out
hero.lede: Emotional exhaustion, loneliness, burnout. Betrayal and loss of trust. Relationships that no longer hold together. In-person sessions in Odesa and online — at your own pace, without judgment.
hero.badgeText: IN PERSON IN ODESA • ONLINE WORLDWIDE

services.headingHtml:
Three themes people
come to me with most often

cards.title: Relationship crises
cards.text: Betrayal, broken trust, relationships falling apart. We figure out whether there's still a way forward together — and how.

cards.title: Burnout & loneliness
cards.text: Emotional exhaustion, the feeling of carrying everything alone. Reconnecting with yourself and your own resources.

cards.title: Teens & self-esteem
cards.text: The crisis of adolescence — and self-confidence at any age.

about.heading: CBT-certified consultant
about.body: I work with adults and teenagers going through a relationship crisis or feeling like they can no longer stay afloat on their own. Certified qualification — "Fundamentals of Cognitive Behavioral Therapy" certificate, 240 academic hours, CBT Association.
